scene.head: with_body
scene.placeText: the top of the long white seawall of her world's harbour capital at sunset — the turquoise sea breaking against the stones below in plumes of golden spray, the colonnaded palaces painted coral, lemon and sky blue glowing tangerine along the shore, tall royal palms swaying and the old fortress lighthouse across the harbour mouth
scene.ownProp: a small guitar of carved pale cedar with three pairs of gleaming golden strings, its sound hole ringed with carved butterfly-shaped flowers
scene.outfit: a sunset musician look fitted to her body — a strapless laced bodice and a high-slit skirt that melts from tangerine to rose, its hem breaking into white foam lace, a short sheer sunset cape, an instrument strap across her shoulder and a wreath of white butterfly-shaped flowers in her hair
scene.scene: she is the son musician of the seawall, standing on its edge and playing her little cedar guitar with both hands as she sings to the evening waves, and where her song reaches the sea the spray turns gold and the waves fall gentle
